echoParts: in the name of the Father
verseText: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit...
meaning: This is the Great Commission: the mission Jesus gave to his followers. Our job is to be disciples who go and make new disciples all over the world.

recall.question: A disciple is someone who learns from Jesus and follows Him. Where did Jesus tell His followers to make disciples?
choices: Only in the land of Israel

meaning.question: What does it mean to make disciples?
choices: Share the good news about Jesus with others and teach them to obey Him
Tell people to just be good

application.prompt: Jesus sent His first followers to make disciples all over the world. If you believe in Him, you can be part of that great mission to spread the good news everywhere. Can you think of someone you can share the good news with?
